recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to white. 2. Draw a thin dark-red (#8B0000) double-line rectangle framing the whole slide with ~2% inset. 3. Add a light gray (#EDEDED) horizontal band across the top (~12% height). 4. Place a dark red (#8B0000) filled rectangle at top-left (~8-38% width) with white bold sans-serif text 'Classification'. 5. At top-right, draw a yellow (#FFFF99) circle with thin red outline containing '36'. 6. Draw a thin red (#C00000) outlined rectangle for the content area (~5-95% width, 15-95% height). 7. Inside, top-left, add bold red text 'Examples of Commonly used classifiers:'. 8. Below it add a bulleted list (round bullets, black text, wide line spacing): Linear Regression; Logistic Regression; Neural Network; Support Vector Machine; Hidden Markov Model; Decision Trees; Bayesian classifier; ....... 9. Use a sans-serif font (e.g., Arial) throughout.
